About Our Company

Building Trusted Layouts & Farm Lands for Over a Decade

AAA Promoterz & Builders is a trusted real-estate and construction company based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. For 10+ years we have been helping families and investors find clear-titled, well-planned residential layouts and fertile farming lands across Maduranthangam, Arakkonam, Thiruthani, Acharapakkam and Kanchipuram — with 100% clear titles on every plot.

Beyond layouts and farm lands, we take on scheduled construction works, supply quality building materials, and execute honest, transparent construction contracts. Every project is handled end-to-end by our founder S Swetha and a responsive local team, so you always know exactly what you are paying for.
